key.name: suwayomi-mode
key.description: Either "local" (bundled server) or "remote" (user-provided URL). Empty means not yet configured.

key.name: suwayomi-url
key.description: The URL of the Suwayomi server the app connects to. Only meaningful when suwayomi-mode is "remote".

key.name: run-in-background
key.summary: Keep the server running in the background
key.description: Keep the local Suwayomi server and the app process running after the window is closed.

key.name: run-on-startup
key.description: Start the local Suwayomi server in the background when the user logs in.

key.name: welcome-shown
key.description: Whether the welcome dialog explaining sources and the Mihon getting started guide has already been shown.

key.name: library-display-mode
key.description: How manga are shown in the library grid.

key.name: library-show-unread-badge
key.description: Show the number of unread chapters on library covers.

key.name: library-show-download-badge
key.description: Show the number of downloaded chapters on library covers.
